about: Read-only reads for gate LIST-13 (Thom and Rodrigo, 2026-10-23): the thirteen Robinhood stock tokens AMC, COST, DJT, GLXY, GME, HIMS, LLY, MRNA, RBLX, RDDT, SNAP, SNDK, TTWO, against the bar of WIDER-LIST. `feedDirectory`: Chainlink's directory for Robinhood Chain mainnet, read 2026-10-23 ~15:41 UTC, and which of the thirteen it names (only GME and SNDK). `identity`: symbol(), decimals(), paused(), the schedule selector 0x97a4064f and the redeploy factory's isAsset(), by eth_call at block 96097359 through https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com (cast). `quotes`: packages/chain-evm/test/pool-quotes.ts for the two with a feed, RH_POOLS_SIZES=1000,2500,4000,5000,10000,25000,50000,250000 RH_POOLS_V3_QUOTES=1, as it wrote it.

quotes.source: Uniswap v4 StateView 0xf3334192d15450cdd385c8b70e03f9a6bd9e673b and Quoter 0x8dc178efb8111bb0973dd9d722ebeff267c98f94 on Robinhood Chain (4663) through robinhood.drpc.org; pools listed through rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com
quotes.method: pool-quotes-0.3: hookless v4 pools against USDG; quoteExactInputSingle for $1,000, $2,500, $4,000, $5,000, $10,000, $25,000, $50,000, $250,000 each way; cost in bps against the pool mid of the same block, fee included; pools of a fee above 1% listed and not quoted; the v3 pools of the token and USDG at fees 100, 500, 3000 and 10000 with their liquidity, observations kept and whether observe([3600, 0]) answers, each quoted at the same sizes by ClQuoter through a state override, cost against its own mid
